title: Complementing a finite nondeterministic machine
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, form a finite nondeterministic machine with the same number of work tapes, the same finite state set, and the same initial state, whose transitions complement every Boolean symbol they emit and otherwise preserve the original transition behavior.
hypotheses_covered: the machine is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
